definitions: To sustain minor damage, dents, or scratches, often from an impact or rough handling.
To experience minor injuries or bruises, typically from an accident or physical activity.
examples: My new car got dinged up in the parking lot.
The package got dinged up during shipping.
He got dinged up playing football.
Don't let your bike get dinged up.
pastTenses: got dinged up, gotten dinged up
